title: A WordPress wp-config backup is served (/wp-config.php.bak)
summary: A backup of wp-config.php is downloadable as source, which hands over the database name, user and password in plain text.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("DB_PASSWORD") and body_contains("DB_NAME") and body_differs(control) and not body_contains("<html")

remediate: Remove the backup from the web root and rotate the database credentials.
